notes_for_editor: Thin record. Only FFLA listings, a Forest Lookouts page and a TopoQuest map name were read; web searches for build or staffing history found nothing usable, and no search snippet is cited. The TopoQuest 'Bennett Lookout Tower' point is about 16 m from the FFLA 'Bennett – first' (gone) point by our calculation, so the map name may belong to the first tower; not corrected in the record. 'Standing' is the FFLA listing only, not a site check. The Wisconsin 2015 DNR closure is not applied: no source says whether Bennett was a DNR tower.
